newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver show mixed trends, arrivals up.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver show mixed trends, arrivals up.

text.p: Indian silver prices ended lower on Thursday after an early rise on increasing arrivals of imported metal, dealers said.
Silver was up by 25 rupees per kg on Wednesday.
"About 2,000 kg of imported silver arrived in the Bombay market on Thursday which eased the recent shortage to some extent," one broker said.
Gold prices, opening easier on the back of sliding world markets, held steady on stray physical support ahead of the wedding season. Gold rose by 10 rupees on Wednesday.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) settled 150 rupees lower at 59,750 rupees. They rose by 150 rupees on Wednesday.
